en.hubeali:
From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If I<sup>asws</sup> were to reconcile between two, it would be more beloved to me<sup>asws</sup> than if I were to give charity with two Dinars’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ibn Mahbub from Hisham ibn Salim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
To improve good relations beween two people is more beloved to me than giving two Dinar in charity.”
